description: The spike family has eventual bound zero, but has no pointwise bound and is not dominating. A spike at i is zero above i, a spike of value g(i)+1 defeats g at i, and no spike eventually dominates the constant one function.
signature:
Lemmatheca.Entry.BoundingAndDominatingFamilies.spikeFamily_spec :
  Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.IsBounded Lemmatheca.Entry.BoundingAndDominatingFamilies.spikeFamily ∧
    (∀ f ∈ Lemmatheca.Entry.BoundingAndDominatingFamilies.spikeFamily, f ≤ᶠ[Filter.atTop] fun x => 0) ∧
      (∀ (i k n : ℕ), i + 1 ≤ n → Function.update (fun x => 0) i k n = 0) ∧
        (∀ (g : ℕ → ℕ) (i : ℕ),
            Function.update (fun x => 0) i (g i + 1) ∈ Lemmatheca.Entry.BoundingAndDominatingFamilies.spikeFamily ∧
              g i < Function.update (fun x => 0) i (g i + 1) i) ∧
          (¬∃ g, ∀ f ∈ Lemmatheca.Entry.BoundingAndDominatingFamilies.spikeFamily, ∀ (n : ℕ), f n ≤ g n) ∧
            (∀ f ∈ Lemmatheca.Entry.BoundingAndDominatingFamilies.spikeFamily, ¬(fun x => 1) ≤ᶠ[Filter.atTop] f) ∧
              ¬Lemmatheca.SetTheory.BoundingAndDominating.IsDominating
                  Lemmatheca.Entry.BoundingAndDominatingFamilies.spikeFamily
